title: Vapor retarders.
officialText:
Where ducts used for cooling are externally insulated, the insulation shall be covered with a vapor retarder
having a maximum permeance of 0.05 perm (2.87 ng/(Pa. s • m2)) or aluminum foil having a minimum thickness of 2 mils (0.05 1
mm). Insulations having a permeance of 0.05 perm (2.87 ng/(P. s • m2)) or less shall not be required to be covered. All joints and
seams shall be sealed to maintain the continuity of the vapor retarder.
